title: Merge the duplicate TextCacheRepository and TextDisplayScreen test files produced by parallel coverage-wave commits
rule: Fowler duplication lens (digest step 3) / TQ-1 (pyramid-shaped, non-bloated suite)

evidence.quote: /// Extended tests for TextCacheRepository covering paths that are
// Extra coverage for TextCacheRepository — exercises the text_cache hit path,
// L1 widget tests for TextDisplayScreen — the text reader (67.5% coverage focus)

why: git log shows text_cache_repository_extra_test.dart (commit be671521, 'coverage-f1') and text_cache_repository_extended_test.dart (commit 80a8399a, 'coverage-f2') were both added the same day, 2026-05-14, by two independent automated coverage passes; each docstring claims to cover gaps in the *original baseline* file, but neither checked the *other new* file. Concretely both assert: text_cache exact-match + parsing, child-verse aggregation + sort-by-number, skip-empty-segment, daily_content fallback, and getCachedRefs — roughly 80% of their combined ~600 lines duplicate each other with cosmetically different fixtures. The same pattern repeats one directory over: text_display_screen_test.dart (added Feb, DNI-33) versus text_display_screen_l1_test.dart (added 2026-05-30, 'coverage w3') — the newer file's loading/offline/error/Hebrew-RTL/mark-complete-button tests re-assert what the older file already asserts, without removing or even referencing it. Cost: a future change to TextCacheRepository.getText's fallback chain or TextDisplayScreen's loading/error copy must be updated in 2-3 near-identical places instead of 1, and CI spends real time re-pumping the same widget states repeatedly.
recommendation: Pick one canonical file per production class: keep text_cache_repository_extended_test.dart, fold the HTML-entity-decoding case from _extra_test.dart into it, delete _extra_test.dart. Keep text_display_screen_l1_test.dart as primary, fold any assertion unique to text_display_screen_test.dart (e.g. the AppBar-shows-sefariaRef case) into it, then delete the old file. Add a one-line note to the coverage-wave tooling/prompt to grep for an existing test file on the target class before creating a new one.
acceptance_criteria: One test file per production class in this area with no cross-file scenario-name overlap greater than 1, and combined line count for the merged pair is lower than the sum of the originals with no loss of branch coverage.
